scope.description: [Scope](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc6749#section-3.3) values granted to the access token.

expires_in.description: Remaining access token lifetime, in seconds.

uid.description: The [`client_id`](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc6749#section-2.2) the access token was issued to.

created_at.description: Issue time, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

iss.description: The [`iss`](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7519#section-4.1.1) claim: the authorization server that issued the access token.

aud.description: The [`aud`](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7519#section-4.1.3) claim: the protected resource the access token was issued for. Present for resource-bound access tokens.

sub.description: The [`sub`](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7519#section-4.1.2) claim: the subject the access token was issued for.

email.description: Email address of the User the access token was issued for. Returned when the granted scopes cover it.

given_name.description: First name of the User the access token was issued for. Returned when the granted scopes cover it.

family_name.description: Last name of the User the access token was issued for. Returned when the granted scopes cover it.
